```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr) 
library(readr)
```
```{r}


# read data sets
genes_data <- read_csv("D:/2025_summer/R/QBS103_GSE157103_genes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)  # 
series_matrix <- read_csv("D:/2025_summer/R/QBS103_GSE157103_series_matrix-1.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)       # 
head(genes_data, 3)
head(series_matrix,3)
```


```{r}
# Subset gene of interest: ABCA1
df <- expr_long %>%
  filter(gene == "ABCA1") %>%                     # 使用 ABCA1
  left_join(series_matrix_clean, by = "participant_id") %>%
  drop_na(age, disease_status, icu_status) %>%
  mutate(group = paste(disease_status, icu_status, sep = "_"))  # 合并两个分类变量

# Boxplot: ABCA1 expression by combined disease_status and icu_status
p_box <- ggplot(df,
                aes(x = group,
                    y = expression,
                    fill = icu_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "ICU Status") +
  labs(
    title = "ABCA1 Expression by Disease Status and ICU Admission",
    x     = "Disease_ICU",
    y     = "ABCA1 Expression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_box)

# Histogram for ABCA1 expression
p_hist <- ggplot(df, aes(x = expression)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1,
                 fill = "#2c7fb8",
                 color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of ABCA1 Expression",
    x     = "ABCA1 Expression",
    y     = "Sample Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_hist)


```



```{r}
# clean
series_matrix_clean <- series_matrix %>%
  mutate(
    disease_status = case_when(
      str_detect(disease_status, "COVID-19") ~ "COVID-19",
      str_detect(disease_status, "non-COVID") ~ "non-COVID",
      TRUE ~ disease_status
    ),
    disease_status = factor(disease_status, levels = c("non-COVID", "COVID-19")),
    icu_status = factor(icu_status, levels = c("no", "yes")),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("male", "female")),  # 
    age = as.numeric(age),
    crp = as.numeric(`crp(mg/l)`)  # 
  ) %>%
  select(participant_id, age, sex, disease_status, icu_status, crp)

# change data format
expr_long <- genes_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "participant_id",
    values_to = "expression"
  )

# ABCA1,CRP,sex
df_abca1 <- expr_long %>%
  filter(gene == "ABCA1") %>%  # 
  left_join(series_matrix_clean, by = "participant_id") %>%
  drop_na(crp, sex)  # delete miss

# print the scatterplot
p_scatter_crp <- ggplot(df_abca1, aes(x = crp, y = expression, color = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +  # trend line
  scale_color_manual(values = c("male" = "#1f77b4", "female" = "#ff7f0e")) +  # color
  labs(
    title = "ABCA1 Expression vs. CRP (Inflammation Marker)",
    subtitle = "Stratified by Sex",
    x = "C-reactive Protein (CRP, mg/L)",
    y = "ABCA1 Expression Level",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# show
print(p_scatter_crp)

```
